addPota: **Add your POTA activation too** — WIPOTA has no exchange of its own. It is scored from the Wisconsin park you activate and the Wisconsin parks you work, as POTA references.
scoring: **Score:** QSOs × unique Wisconsin parks. A station counts once per band and mode; 60, 30, 17 and 12 m do not count. A park you operate from is a multiplier once it has 10 QSOs.
submit: **Submit** by the end of September at [wipota.com/logs]({{url}}). The form asks for the three counts on the score panel.
